objective: Use existing Michigan tool authority as a connected trip-planning network so seasonal traffic can continue into relevant live tools without creating thin URLs or resetting active search experiments.

dimensions.definition: Fall pages load a contextual trip stack that routes by region into existing tools.
At least eight Michigan region stacks map to useful, non-duplicative destinations.
The fall-this-weekend page carries crawlable fallback links and upgrades to the best-region stack after ranking.
The Manistee tool hands off into live trout, salmon, Au Sable and broader trip planning without changing its search ownership.
Cross-tool handoffs emit one stable symbolic event without precise location or personal data.
Protected running search experiments retain their exact search-facing titles.
llms.txt describes the trip-network relationships for machine discovery.

outcomeTargets.primary: Increase qualified multi-tool sessions and strengthen internal topical relationships while protected CTR tests finish.
outcomeTargets.search: Use the next comparable Search Console exports to look for impression growth on linked river/trip tools and CTR movement on fall pages.
outcomeTargets.behavior: Measure Contextual Tool Handoff by source surface and destination; establish a baseline before setting a conversion-rate target.
outcomeTargets.rule: Build quality is a release gate, not a traffic forecast.

fatalPenalties: Create a new indexable landing URL only to join existing tools.
Change a protected title, description, H1, first answer, canonical, structured data or indexability during its measurement window.
Collect or transmit precise location, typed destination, cookies, local/session storage, fingerprinting or personal identifiers for the trip stack.
Replace a destination tool's primary decision with generic related-link clutter.
Touch the open Lake Superior Circle Tour agent branch source files.
